name: Bowmark
description: Search a library of typed, tested functions for live websites like LinkedIn, Amazon and YouTube, then run short scripts that call them and return structured results, through a hosted endpoint that needs a Bowmark API key (new accounts start with a free $10).

inputs.label: Bowmark API Key
inputs.description: Required. Sent as an Authorization: Bearer header to the hosted endpoint.

obtain.instructions:
1. Go to bowmark.ai and sign up or sign in
2. Open Dashboard > API keys
3. Create a key
4. Copy it into this field

auth.instructions: Create an API key at bowmark.ai/dashboard/keys. It is sent as an Authorization: Bearer header. New accounts start with a free $10.
